content:
zoe: opened a docs PR to add a migration playbook for customers moving from Dedicated -> Private (VPC/on-prem). Focus: network checklist, KMS rebind steps, HSM certchain, airgapped bootstrap notes, Ansible snippet for firewall rules, and a tiny Rust SDK example for unix-socket endpoints. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1602

rahul: skimmed. high level looks good. two important callsouts: 1) emphasize the order of operations when re-binding KMS (unbind on old cluster, rotate client certs, update kms-proxy config, then bind on new cluster). 2) include a short rollback plan if the HSM agent fails to mount the PKCS#11 socket.

maria: can you add an example Ansible task to ensure nftables/iptables rules are present? some customers still use iptables-legacy. Also add a systemd drop-in example for kms-proxy and a note about SELinux contexts.

evans: adding a small Ansible snippet and a Rust SDK example for unix sockets (we haven't used Rust in docs before so this will be helpful for some infra folks). here's the Rust snippet suggestion to include under "SDK examples":```rust
use std::env;
use std::path::Path;
let path = Path::new("/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock");
let endpoint = format!("unix://{}", path.to_str().unwrap());
let client = KmsClient::connect(&endpoint).expect("connect");
```
Also Ansible snippet for nftables/iptable rule idempotent ensure:```yaml
- name: allow KMS port for tls endpoints (example)
  ansible.builtin.iptables:
    chain: INPUT
    protocol: tcp
    destination_port: 443
    jump: ACCEPT
    state: present
- name: ensure unix socket acl for kms user
  ansible.builtin.command: setfacl -m u:kms:rw /var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock
  args:
    warn: false
```

zoe: perfect. For the KMS rebind steps I'm adding a numbered walkthrough and a short table of expected downtime windows for different migration patterns (cold cutover vs staged). Rahul, can you draft the rollback bullets?

rahul: sure — rollback bullets: 1) restore previous kms-proxy config and env, 2) revert certs to previous version (ensure private keys in HSM are still present), 3) rebind old cluster endpoint, 4) run smoke tests (token fetch, keylist, sign op). I'll paste into the PR.

maria: systemd drop-in example to include (drop-in preferred over full unit):```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/kms-proxy.service.d/10-local.conf
[Service]
Environment=KMS_CONFIG=/etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml
Restart=on-failure
LimitNOFILE=65536
User=kms
```
Add troubleshooting: `journalctl -u kms-proxy -n 200` and check `ss -xl | grep pkcs11` for socket. Also add SELinux tip: `semanage fcontext -a -t httpd_var_run_t '/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock' && restorecon -v /var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock` (or use correct label for your policy).

docs-bot: docs-lint results: link-check: 0 broken links, spelling: 1 warning ("priviledged" -> "privileged"), accessibility: svg alt missing for the topology (please add alt when you commit assets). CI preview: https://deploy-preview-1602--docs.redwood.ai/migrate-dedicated-to-private

ez: tiny nit: in the Ansible iptables example, we should show both nftables and iptables-legacy paths or a note: "if using nftables, use nft module; iptables shown for legacy examples."

zoe: good call. I'll add a note and include an example nftables rule too. I'll wait for one more approval then merge. @evan can you squash the Rust snippet commit into the PR and add alt text for the topology SVG?

evans: will squash and push in a minute. lgtm from my side.

rahul: lgtm for rollback bullets and order-of-ops.

zoe: merging in ~15m unless anything else pops up. thanks all :shipit:
